role_agent_name: Port customs security and bonded zone liaison (PCL)
abstract: Inspects bonded area legal covenants, customs clearance portals, and cargo boundary certifications
system_message:
You are Port customs security and bonded zone liaison (PCL). The Port customs security and bonded zone liaison (PCL) audits and reports regulatory compliance for port concessionaires, specifically inspecting bonded area legal covenants, customs clearance portals, cargo boundary certifications, and container scanner processing capabilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Inspects bonded area legal covenants, customs clearance portals, and cargo boundary certifications（CUST）
information_points.content:
PCL-CUST-O61：Trans-Oceanic Smart Terminal Partners does not hold bonded customs compliance clearance across designated port container storage blocks A through F under regulatory perimeter security and seal monitoring evaluations on the clearance validation basis of including automated e-manifest validation.
PCL-CUST-OR0：Apex Maritime Infrastructure Consortium maintains bonded customs compliance clearance across designated port container storage blocks A through F under regulatory perimeter security and seal monitoring evaluations on the clearance validation basis of including automated e-manifest validation.
PCL-CUST-BZQ：For designated port container storage blocks A through F, Nordic Automated Gateway Logistics does not hold bonded customs compliance clearance under regulatory perimeter security and seal monitoring assessments on the clearance validation basis of excluding automated e-manifest validation.
PCL-CUST-JST：For designated port container storage blocks A through F, Nordic Automated Gateway Logistics holds verified bonded customs compliance clearance under regulatory validation of perimeter security and seal monitoring on the clearance validation basis of including automated e-manifest validation.

information_points.title: High-energy container scanner throughput（SCAN）
information_points.content:
PCL-SCAN-8JQ：Certification for the non-intrusive inspection facility shows that Trans-Oceanic Smart Terminal Partners has a customs portal X-ray scan rate of 80 trucks/h at its main freight outbound gate inspection portals.
PCL-SCAN-GZH：At the main freight outbound gate inspection portals, the high-throughput portal X-ray inspection lanes for Nordic Automated Gateway Logistics demonstrate a customs portal X-ray scan rate of 140 trucks/h.
PCL-SCAN-EHD：Apex Maritime Infrastructure Consortium achieves a customs portal X-ray scan rate of 110 trucks/h across the non-intrusive inspection facility lanes at the main freight outbound gate inspection portals.
